offering_description.value: Pacira sells injectable drugs and a cryoneurolysis device to hospitals, surgery centers and specialty clinics for postoperative pain and knee pain. It develops extended-release drug formulations and supplies its products through specialty distributors and wholesalers.

primary_products.value: Liposomal bupivacaine injection; extended-release triamcinolone injection for knee osteoarthritis; handheld cryoneurolysis devices and disposable treatment tips

customer_segment.value: B2B: Hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, orthopedic practices and pain management clinics

end_markets.value: Perioperative care; orthopedics; interventional pain management

revenue_model.value: product sales: Injectable drugs, cryoneurolysis devices and disposable treatment tips

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Develops finished injectable drugs and cryoneurolysis equipment for hospitals, surgery centers and specialty clinics

specialization.value: related lines: Postsurgical local anesthetics, knee osteoarthritis injections and cryoneurolysis equipment

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Specialty pharmaceutical distributors and wholesalers supplying healthcare facilities; direct sales: Field sales teams serving hospitals, surgery centers and specialty practices

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA approval for prescription drugs, FDA clearance for cryoneurolysis devices and manufacturing quality requirements

notes: Current commercial reach outside the United States is uncertain.
